name: /help explains the bot in plain language

payload.text: ℹ️ How to use Crypto Watchlist Alerts This bot tracks cryptocurrency prices and alerts you when they hit your targets. Getting started: • Tap /start to open the menu • Add coins to your watchlist • Set price alerts for each coin • Check prices anytime Features: • ➕ Add Coin — track any cryptocurrency • 💰 Check Price — see current prices and 24h changes • 🔔 Set Alert — get notified when prices hit your targets • 📊 My Watchlist — see all tracked coins • 📅 Daily Summary — get a daily price report Alerts: • Price threshold — notify when price goes above/below a value • Percentage change — notify when price changes by a % Everything is controlled by buttons — just tap what you need.
